import re, pathlib
# Pattern only - never name a token literal, because naming one in a
# tool call is exactly how it keeps getting written back into the log.
PAT = re.compile(rb"(gh[pousr]_)[A-Za-z0-9]{36}|(github_pat_)[A-Za-z0-9_]{50,}")
def sub(m):
    return (m.group(1) or m.group(2)) + b"<redacted>"
for name in (".ai-log/session.jsonl", ".ai-log/archive/2026-08-26.jsonl"):
    p = pathlib.Path(name)
    raw = p.read_bytes()
    out, n = PAT.subn(sub, raw)
    if n:
        p.write_bytes(out)
    print(f"{name}: {n} credential-shaped string(s) redacted")
PY
